web.title: 2020 Data and Evaluation - AI CITY CHALLENGE
web.description:
## Data and Evaluation Method
Data for this challenge comes from multiple traffic cameras from a city in the United States as well as from state highways in Iowa.

The data set contains 31 video clips (about 9 hours in total) captured from 20 unique camera views (some cameras provide multiple video clips to cover different lighting and weather conditions.).

In our case, K=100.

The dataset contains 215.03 minutes of videos collected from 46 cameras spanning 16 intersections in a mid-sized U.S. city. The distance between the two furthest simultaneous cameras is 4 km.
